about: events' application mutants (wf10 SJ2); each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: events-bytes-keeps-last
mutants.rule: A tally adds the bytes of every send, whatever their order (law AddIsOrderFree).

mutants.name: events-closed-uncounted
mutants.rule: Every event counts once, in its own kind (law AddCountsEach).

mutants.name: events-open-ignores-failed
mutants.rule: A connection that failed has ended: a generated log of whole connections leaves none open (law GeneratedIsBalanced).

mutants.name: events-lines-read-as-one-value
mutants.rule: events lines reads newline-delimited JSON, a sequence of values (case lines).
